item.title: San Jose police seek help in identifying fatal hit-and-run suspect
item.description: The collision happened Jan. 25 at South Bascom Avenue and Borello Drive.

item.title: New York Jets hire ex-Stanford interim coach Frank Reich as offensive coordinator
item.description: Reich spent last year as Stanford’s interim head coach, replacing Troy Taylor, and led the Cardinal to their most victories since 2020.

item.title: Alameda County real estate: House on Oakland Avenue sells for $2.8 million
item.description: The spacious historic unit in the 1100 block of Oakland Avenue in Piedmont was sold on Dec. 2, 2025 for $2,801,500, or $1,072 per square foot.

item.title: Woman assaulted during attempted robbery in Palo Alto
item.description: The incident happened Tuesday morning in the 700 block of East Meadow Drive.

item.title: High surf advisory for Bay Area Shorelines for Friday and Saturday – waves of 17 to 22 feet forecast
item.description: Coastal North Bay including Point Reyes National Seashore, San Francisco Peninsula Coast, Northern Monterey Bay and Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast as well as San Francisco County are the focus of a high surf advisory issued at 8:37 p.m. on Wednesday by the National Weather Service. The advisory is valid from Friday 4 a.m. until Saturday Feb. 7, at 9 p.m.

item.title: Beach hazards statement for Bay Area Shorelines for Thursday and Friday
item.description: Coastal North Bay including Point Reyes National Seashore, San Francisco Peninsula Coast, Northern Monterey Bay and Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast as well as San Francisco County are included in a beach hazards statement issued by the National Weather Service on Wednesday at 8:37 p.m. The statement is valid from Thursday midnight until Friday Feb. 6, at 4 a.m.

item.title: Warriors trade Jonathan Kuminga to Hawks on eve of deadline
item.description: Golden State gets Kristaps Porzingis in deal for Kuminga and Buddy Hield.

item.title: Askarov shines, but late goal dooms Sharks in loss to Avalanche
item.description: Avalanche defenseman Josh Manson scores winning goal with 7:16 left in regulation time

item.title: Bay Area flag football, NFL stars light up Super Bowl LX at glow-in-the-dark Toyota Glow-Up Classic
item.description: NFL All-Pros and top Bay Area high school flag football players showed out for a showcase of how much the game has grown during the Super Bowl LX festivities at Moscone Center.

item.title: How Kristaps Porzingis fits with Warriors after Kuminga trade
item.description: Kristaps Porzingis is a knockdown shooter and intimidating rim protector … when he is healthy
